summary.text: NORLANDIA ELTONÅSEN BARNEHAGE AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2022-10-28. NORLANDIA ELTONÅSEN BARNEHAGE AS operates a kindergarten (barnehage) and activities that are naturally connected to this. Its main industry code is 85.100: pre-primary education. In its 2024 accounts, total operating income was 19 995 324 NOK and the annual result was 1 326 941 NOK; operating income was up from 18 339 886 NOK in 2023. The annual result fell from 1 326 941 NOK in 2024 to 1 002 677 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 2 045 649 NOK in 2023 to 2 045 648 NOK in 2024. Registered leadership: Heidi Thowsen Aastorp (daglig leder) and Kristin Voldsnes (styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 29 on 2025-11-13 to 32 on 2026-08-13. The register's most recent update was on 2026-08-13 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
